column2: Similarly, the CSC will also have environmental and social monitors who will supervise and

column1: monitor the contractors for effective EMP implementation. The contractors in turn will also have HSE
supervisors who will ensure EMP implementation during construction activities and will be tasked to
develop necessary detailed HSE plans as per this EMP and oversee their implementation. However, this
will not involve monitoring and evaluation of EMP due to limited nature of impacts.
